ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Dashboard password. Leave empty to have one generated (see data/.admin-token).

SENSOR_API_KEY.description: Key sensor webhooks send in X-Api-Key. Leave empty to have one generated.

HOTDESK_DEMO.description: Set to 1 to run the sensor simulator so the dashboard shows live demo data.

HOTDESK_PUBLIC.description: Set to 1 to make the app's port public (needed for phones scanning QR labels and for sensor webhooks).
